chunks: There is no dying person, at whose death Allah, Mighty and Glorious, does not restore to him some of his sight, hearing, and intellect, whether taking up the will or leaving it. And that is the relief which is called the relief of death.

key_terms.الْوَفَاةُ: death; the moment of passing away
key_terms.رَاحَةُ الْمَوْتِ: the ease or relief experienced at death
key_terms.مَيِّتٍ: a dying person at the approach of death

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say happens to a person’s awareness at the moment of death?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that when death comes, Allah restores to the dying person awareness through sight, hearing, and intellect. The hadith describes this state as the relief or ease associated with death, including the moment in which a person may make or leave a final will.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.374 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"There is no dying person for whom Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, does not return their sight, hearing, and intellect at the moment of death, whether they are giving a final will or not. This is the 'relief of death' that is referred to as the comfort of passing away."
